description: This PHP source file manages the import of custom fields in the TestLink project. It includes functions for initializing arguments, handling file uploads, parsing XML content, and creating or updating custom fields via the cfield_mgr class. It also sets up the page display with templating and handles user permissions.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Class responsible for managing custom field operations such as retrieval, creation, and updates in the database.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Class used for defining input parameter types for request parsing.

methods.name: doImport
methods.description: Handles the import of custom fields from an uploaded XML file, creating new fields that do not already exist.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for action processing and sets default parameters.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permission to manage custom fields.
